info.title: probectl control-plane API
info.description: Operational endpoints plus the versioned /v1 resource API. Protected /v1 routes resolve the tenant from the authenticated session/OIDC principal, then enforce the tenant boundary before RBAC/ABAC. The X-Probectl-Tenant header is a local dev-auth/test override only; release binaries do not accept it as an identity source.

The artifact is privacy-redacted, audited, and expires no later than the tenant object-retention policy. It is not a public bearer link.

The embedded public key proves integrity; verify its fingerprint out of band to prove operator identity. In addition to incident.read, ai.query is re-authorized tenant-first before evidence gathering.

post.summary: Compare two explicit Explorer windows inside one tenant
post.description: Resolves tenant scope from authentication before source RBAC and the tenant ABAC deny-override, then runs the same bounded source dispatch for the current and previous windows. Numeric measures are aligned by the requested groupings with explicit missing-current, missing-previous, and zero-baseline states. Only sources with exact historical-window reads are accepted; current-state-only sources fail closed. The response includes sanitized logical execution receipts for both windows and alignment; it never exposes SQL, physical plans, tenant identity, or literal filter values.

get.description: Read-only CI lookup against the configured CMDB provider (ServiceNow or NetBox). The CMDB is one deployment-level system shared by every tenant, so a key is answerable only when the caller's own tenant has an agent, a device or an incident target by that name (DPR-118); anything else is 404, which deliberately does not reveal whether the CI exists elsewhere. 503 when no provider is configured.

get.summary: Secret-backend health (S41)
get.description: Per-backend operational health of the S41 secrets resolver: configured schemes (env/vault/cyberark/aws/azure/gcp), resolve/failure counters, live (unexpired) lease counts, last success time, and the last REDACTED error. Never contains secret material or reference fragments. resolver_running=false distinguishes an unwired resolver from a healthy-but-idle one. Requires directory read (admin surface).

get.summary: Editions / license state (S-T0)
get.description: The deployment's edition truth: tier (core/enterprise/msp), informational pricing model (flat/consumption), lifecycle state (community, active, grace, read_only), customer + expiry + read-only horizon when licensed, the MSP tenant band and meter vocabulary, and the full gated-feature table with per-feature licensed/mode status. This endpoint is the ONE place tiers appear when unlicensed (the hidden-unlicensed UX): commercial features are otherwise invisible without an entitlement. TenantHeader.name: X-Probectl-Tenant
TenantHeader.description: Local dev-auth/test tenant override. In release/session mode the tenant is resolved from the authenticated principal, and this header is not an identity credential.

version.description: Bumped on every behavioral change of the rule.

suppress.description: Re-raise suppression window per entity, Go duration (e.g. 1h0m0s).

overlay_dir.description: PROBECTL_NDR_RULES_DIR as loaded; empty when only the embedded defaults are in force.

kind.description: What is being suggested. probectl never executes any of them.

title.description: One-line statement of the suggested change.

rationale.description: The RCA / topology reasoning that grounds the suggestion.

target.description: The affected topology element (a node id such as hop:10.0.0.1, service:<id> or prefix:<cidr>). When set, the read-only dry-run sizes its blast radius through the what-if simulation; an unknown target yields an unknown blast radius, which cannot be approved.

note.description: The human's decision note, written to the audit trail.

blast_radius.description: Impacted services + prefixes + newly-disconnected hosts. Above PROBECTL_REMEDIATION_MAX_BLAST_RADIUS the proposal cannot be approved.

state.description: proposed → approved | rejected by a human; applied is recorded by an operator after carrying the change out themselves.

approvals_enabled.description: PROBECTL_REMEDIATION_APPROVALS_ENABLED — false means review-only: Approve is unavailable.

confirm.description: Must equal the tenant's slug (case-insensitive). Anything else is refused.

byok_ref.description: Secret-backend reference of the customer key (required when mode=byok); resolved before activation.

shared.description: Shares only within the same tenant; RBAC still applies.
Shares only inside the importing tenant.

confirm.description: False validates and previews only; true explicitly creates a new dashboard.

download_url.description: Same-origin authenticated path; never an external URL.

token_overrides.description: Deployment-wide allowlisted CSS design-token values. Absent means the shipped dark/aurora themes are unmodified.

audit_retention.description: Aggregate audit-retention posture. Carries no tenant data or audit payloads; reports whether raw in-DB audit rows can age out behind WORM/SIEM export watermarks.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable API error codes. Clients branch on this enum; message is human-facing and may be localized.

ErrorDetail.description: The inner API error object. Code is stable and machine-readable; message is human-facing; request_id joins client output to server logs.

Error.description: The standard error envelope returned by every endpoint.

ReadinessAction.description: A safe, non-executing action within the self-hosted deployment.

ReadinessFinding.description: A deterministic local readiness issue. Healthy checks omit this object.

SelfMetricsSnapshot.description: A point-in-time snapshot of this control-plane process. It is deployment-local and contains no tenant identity, labels, or telemetry.

TestRequest.description: The mutable fields of a synthetic test.

target.description: Required for all types except noop. For browser tests this is the start URL unless params.script supplies start_url.

params.description: Per-type string parameters. For browser tests, params.script may carry browser.Script JSON; when omitted, the agent runs a default transaction that opens target and expects HTTP 200.

config.description: The receipt for the enrolled agent (DPR-065): the exact canaries: entry to add to the agent config, in the agent's own keys, including this definition's test_id.

canary.description: One entry of the agent's canaries: list (type, target, interval, timeout, params, test_id); render it as YAML.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent when the last page was returned (SCALE-002).

labels.description: Bounded operator-supplied local metadata reported on the authenticated agent channel. region and site drive the owned-vantage coverage matrix; no geolocation lookup is performed.

FleetSafeAction.description: Exactly one read-only, authorized next step. The action opens tenant-scoped evidence or the human-gated rollout runbook; it never updates an agent.

allOf.description: Tenant-scoped fleet action-center view. Health and rollout fields are derived from authenticated registry heartbeats, the N/N-1 lifecycle policy, reported capabilities, and persisted staged-rollout plans.

identity_expires_at.description: When this agent's current SVID stops being an identity. Absent when no issuance is recorded for it.

identity_state.description: Credential lifetime, not liveness: an agent keeps working on the identity it holds and then stops for good, so rotation failing is invisible in the heartbeat until it is too late (DPR-176). renewal_overdue means the identity is past 75% of its lifetime with no rotation recorded; unknown means no issuance is recorded and the lifetime cannot be read, never that it is healthy.

last_failure.description: Most relevant known rollout, heartbeat, capability, or unsupported-version failure; empty when none is recorded.

agent_transport_running.description: Whether the agent gRPC lane is enabled in this deployment. False means no agent can report at all, so an empty or uniformly stale fleet is a control plane that is not listening rather than a fleet that stopped.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent when the last page was returned (SCALE-010).

control_version.description: Control-plane version used to derive N/N-1 agent version health.

rollouts_available.description: Whether persisted staged-rollout evidence was available while building this page.

state.description: ready means operational/data observed, quiet means running without tenant data, and blocked means unavailable or unhealthy.

next_action.description: Tenant-relative UI route for the next useful action.

agent_enroll_token_created.description: True once this tenant has minted at least one agent enrollment token. The token value remains show-once only.

agent_registered.description: True once at least one agent row exists for this tenant.

agent_connected.description: True once a tenant-bound producer has completed an authenticated transport registration or heartbeat; identity issuance alone is not a connection.

producer_healthy.description: True while at least one tenant-bound producer has a current online heartbeat.

first_test_created.description: True once at least one synthetic test exists for this tenant.

first_result_received.description: True once the server has retained a real result in this tenant's result partition.

first_finding_visible.description: True once a named, navigable finding receipt is available.

scim_token_created.description: True once at least one SCIM provisioning token row exists for this tenant.

readiness_steps_complete.description: Count of operational milestones only: connected, healthy, result, finding. Setup artifacts do not advance it.

HopGeo.description: Approximate responder location, sourced exclusively from operator-supplied data (PROBECTL_HOP_GEO_FILE); no external geolocation service is ever contacted.

HopNode.description: One responder at a TTL; multiple nodes at a TTL are ECMP branches.

PathMeasurementFidelity.description: Versioned acquisition receipt for one path snapshot. Legacy snapshots omit this object rather than inferring capabilities. Current RTTs use the application monotonic clock; kernel and hardware timestamp booleans are true only when actually used.

PathSnapshot.description: One immutable path-discovery round. The opaque ID is always read under tenant_id and target scope.

secret.description: Webhook HMAC secret; redacted (***) in responses.

labels.description: Authorized series labels with ambient tenant_id removed.

owner_id.description: Authenticated user that owns this preset inside the tenant.

Signal.description: One plane's observation on an incident timeline (extensible: plane/kind are free-form, attributes is arbitrary).

id.description: Durable tenant-scoped signal row identifier used for an audited ungroup action.

signal_count.description: Total durable signal count, including evidence omitted by the bounded detail response.

signals_truncated.description: True when the incident has more evidence than this response returns; omitted evidence is a coverage gap, never a healthy zero.

signals_limit.description: Maximum number of time-ordered signals returned when signals_truncated is true.

correlation_overrides.description: Active and reversed operator decisions for this source incident; history never disappears.

correlation_running.description: Whether cross-plane incident correlation is running in this deployment. False means no incident can ever be raised here, so an empty items array is a stopped correlator and not a quiet tenant.

effective_limit.description: The bound the server actually applied (500).

truncated.description: True when the tenant has more rows than effective_limit, so items is the newest page and not the whole set.

evidence_id.description: Exact cited evidence ID inside that share artifact.

state.description: Unavailable is fail-closed: no source details are returned after the cited share/evidence stops authorizing.

body.description: Human-authored inert plain text; it is never interpreted as a prompt, tool call, runbook, or markup.

Me.description: The authenticated caller: the resolved tenant (always present), identity, and the effective RBAC permission keys within that tenant.

tenant_name.description: Tenant display name read under the authenticated tenant's RLS scope.

tenant_slug.description: Tenant slug read under the authenticated tenant's RLS scope.

time_zone.description: The caller's preferred IANA timezone. Defaults to UTC when no user preference is known.

locale.description: The caller's preferred BCP 47 locale tag. Defaults to en when no user preference is known.

tenant_time_zone.description: The tenant default IANA timezone. User preference wins when both are present.

tenant_locale.description: The tenant default BCP 47 locale tag. User preference wins when both are present.

AuditEvent.description: One record in the tenant's hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. Privacy erasure is a projection: actor/target/data can be returned as erased tokens, while prev_hash/hash remain the raw-chain proof.

actor.description: Who performed the action (email, user id, or an erased-subject projection token).

target.description: The id of the affected resource.

data.description: Structured event data after audit privacy projection. If subject erasure applied, matching values are replaced with an erased token and _probectl_privacy describes the projection.

reason.description: Required non-whitespace investigation purpose, limited by the server to 512 UTF-8 bytes after trimming. The CLI reads it from stdin or an owner-only regular file so it does not appear in process arguments.

operator.description: The operator identity retained under encryption.

OncallStatus.description: Read-only, tenant-scoped on-call/ITSM posture. Secrets and endpoint path/query values are intentionally omitted.

id.description: Opaque connector id for test delivery; unique only within the caller tenant's status response.

tenant_routed.description: True when the connector is registered only for the caller tenant.

endpoint_host.description: Host:port metadata only; URL path, query, and credentials are never returned.

SIEMStatus.description: Read-only SIEM export posture. Endpoint path/query and ingest token are intentionally omitted.

format.description: Resolved format when valid; raw configured value when reason=invalid_format.

endpoint_host.description: Only scheme-free host:port metadata; path, query, and credentials are never returned.

next.description: Cursor to pass as ?after= for the next page (0 when no more).

detail.description: Present when ok=false: where and how the chain is broken.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. "why is api.example.com slow?"

subject.description: Optional explicit subject pins (target, prefix, node, incident_id). Tenant and evidence scope are rejected because they come only from authentication and authorized queries.

filters.description: Bounded source fields only. tenant, tenant_id, and semantic variants are rejected.

comparison_sources.description: Sources whose tenant-scoped dispatch honors both explicit historical windows. Current-state-only sources are omitted.

ExplorerExecutionBounds.description: The normalized time and row bounds enforced by the server.

ExplorerExecutionTimings.description: Server-measured logical stage timings. Values can be zero for sub-millisecond work.

recipe.description: The allow-listed recipe ID or custom. It never contains question or filter text.

tenant_scoped.description: True only after the authenticated principal tenant has been resolved and supplied to the source query.

filter_keys.description: Sorted allow-listed filter field names. Literal values are deliberately omitted.

source_rows.description: Rows produced by the already tenant-scoped logical source before response shaping.

ExplorerExecutionReceipt.description: A sanitized logical execution receipt. It never contains SQL, physical plans, tenant identity, literal filter values, secrets, or datastore-wide cardinality.

ExplorerComparisonExecutionReceipt.description: Two tenant-scoped logical receipts plus the bounded local alignment stage.

ExplorerComparisonRequest.description: The query carries the current absolute window. The previous window is explicit and independently validated. Tenant scope is never accepted in the body.

AIQueryRange.description: The current investigation time window. Both bounds are server-validated; start must not be after end.

fields.description: Allow-listed source fields used to resolve a citation back to its authorized source object.

silent_planes.description: Cause-bearing planes that contributed no evidence to this verdict. A silent plane is unverified, not clean: it may have nothing wrong, or it may not be deployed. The root_cause text says so as well, and confidence is capped when the verdict rests on a single plane while others were silent.

adapter.description: Server-reported adapter that produced the rendered answer.

attempted_adapter.description: Present only when the built-in synthesizer answered after a configured adapter failed.

AIReasoningProvenance.description: Server-authored sovereignty state. Clients must not infer locality from model names or configuration text.

prompt.description: e.g. "check Salesforce login from every branch"

params.description: Per-type string parameters. For browser tests, params.script may carry browser.Script JSON.

ChangeEvent.description: A normalized tenant-scoped change event from a signed webhook or a content-free read-time projection.

ConfigChangeReference.description: Content-free reference to the exact redacted device config snapshots behind a projected drift event.

change_ingest_configured.description: Whether any signed change-ingest webhook credential is registered for this tenant. False means nothing can deliver change events here, so an empty timeline is an unconfigured integration and not a period in which nothing changed.

config_archive_running.description: Whether the device-configuration archive that projects config revisions into the change timeline is wired.

effective_limit.description: The bound the server actually applied (200).

truncated.description: True when the tenant has more rows than effective_limit, so items is the newest page and not the whole set.

BGPEvent.description: A tenant-scoped BGP/routing signal projected from the incident timeline.

DeviceInventory.description: One managed network device visible in the tenant topology graph.

DeviceMetricSummary.description: Latest retained sample for one device/metric/interface series.

content.description: Raw submitted config; stored and returned after common secret redaction.

EBPFServiceEdge.description: One tenant-scoped eBPF host/L7 service edge aggregate.

ChangeCandidate.description: A change scored as a candidate cause of an incident.

correlation_running.description: Whether cross-plane incident correlation is running in this deployment. False means no incident can ever be raised here, so an empty items array is a stopped correlator and not a quiet tenant.

effective_limit.description: The bound the server actually applied (500).

truncated.description: True when more candidate changes fell in the window than effective_limit.

ABACPolicy.description: An ABAC policy evaluated after RBAC (deny-override).

TenantIdPSettings.description: Public metadata for the caller tenant's OIDC provider. Secret material is represented only by client_secret_configured.

issuer.description: HTTPS issuer URL, or an empty string when no IdP is configured.

redirect_url.description: HTTPS callback URL, or an empty string when no IdP is configured.

TenantIdPSettingsInput.description: Tenant OIDC override. client_secret is write-only; omit it to preserve an existing encrypted secret.

SCIMToken.description: A SCIM bearer-token metadata row. The token hash and plaintext token are never returned from list/get responses.

DirectoryUser.description: A user of the caller's tenant with the role slugs bound at tenant scope.

DirectoryUserCreate.description: Create a person before their first SSO login so a role is waiting for them; role is a slug (admin, editor, viewer or a custom role).

SCIMTokenCreated.description: The one-time SCIM bearer token response. The token value is never retrievable again.

FlowTopRow.description: One top-talkers row. key is the address/ASN per the grouping; detail carries the pair destination or AS organization name. exporter_count counts distinct non-empty tenant-scoped exporter identities; zero means identity unavailable. It does not claim packet or conversation deduplication.

exporter_count.description: Distinct non-empty exporter identities contributing to this tenant-scoped aggregate. Zero means exporter identity unavailable. Multiple exporters may observe overlapping traffic, so this is observation multiplicity, not a deduplicated packet or conversation count.

ingest_running.description: Whether this deployment has the flow plane's ingest ledger wired. False means nothing is receiving flow at all, so an empty items array is a blocked producer and not a tenant with no traffic.

series.description: Bucketed history for at most the first six ranked contributors.

exporter_count.description: Distinct non-empty exporter identities contributing to this tenant-scoped time bucket. Zero means exporter identity unavailable. This is observation multiplicity, not packet or conversation deduplication.

ingest_running.description: Whether this deployment has the flow plane's ingest ledger wired. False means nothing is receiving flow at all, so an empty items array is a blocked producer and not a tenant with no traffic.
Whether this deployment has the flow plane's ingest ledger wired. False means nothing is receiving flow at all, so an empty items array is a blocked producer and not a tenant with no traffic.

flow_retention_days.description: Per-tenant flow retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

otel_retention_days.description: Per-tenant OTLP trace/log retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

ebpf_retention_days.description: Per-tenant eBPF aggregate retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

path_retention_days.description: Per-tenant raw path/traceroute retention in days where the backend supports pruning; null uses the deployment default.

audit_retention_days.description: Per-tenant local audit retention in days; null inherits the deployment window, and a finite value may only tighten a positive deployment maximum. Pruning still requires the tenant's durable SIEM watermark.

ai_answer_retention_days.description: Per-tenant persisted AI-answer retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

object_retention_days.description: Per-tenant object-artifact retention target in days; enforcement may be delegated to the object store lifecycle.

derived_identity_retention_days.description: Per-tenant topology/endpoint derived identity-cache retention in days; null uses the deployment default.

audit_retention_days.description: Stored per-tenant audit-retention tightening; null inherits the deployment window.

detail.description: Sanitized RLS health detail. Full catalog/role errors stay in control-plane logs to avoid exposing tenant schema identifiers.

error.description: Sanitized routing error for this tenant only.

ExecutionCadenceReceipt.description: Bounded, read-only evidence about scheduled synthetic execution. current_assignment_verified is false because agents load local YAML and the control plane does not own or inspect that current assignment.

window_seconds.description: Requested evidence horizon. history_complete is false when this horizon crosses process startup or tenant-local ring eviction.

expected_rounds.description: Distinct observed rounds plus deterministic misses after each observed agent's first exact result; never infers rounds before local assignment is evidenced.

observed_rounds.description: Distinct exact-test result deliveries in the bounded window after deduplication.

missed_rounds.description: Configured interval slots absent between exact observations and as_of, with the documented scheduling grace.

current_assignment_verified.description: Always false until a separately approved signed local-assignment verification design exists.

token.description: One-time pjt_ enrollment token minted for the caller tenant.

hostname.description: Optional operator label or collector host/source name.

csr_pem.description: Router-owned PKCS#10 CSR PEM. Required only for plane=bmp; the private key never leaves the router.

collection_profile.description: Optional compiled device evidence-budget profile. Valid only when plane=device; defaults to standard.

yaml.description: Keys and values to put in the collector's YAML config.

additionalProperties.description: A string value, or a nested mapping when the collector reads the key nested (for example bus: {namespace: t-<slug>}); render it as-is into the collector YAML (DPR-053).

startup_command.description: Optional command to start the matching collector binary with the returned env/YAML hints.

cert_pem.description: Issued leaf plus intermediate certificate chain.

ca_bundle.description: Operator-owned root plus intermediate trust bundle.
